SCP-395 is to be fed one liter of a half-and-half mixture of blood and milk, both taken from the same individual, once a week.

That makes it Euclid. Safe can be locked in a box and forgotten about. Euclid requires an occasional checkup, at a minimum.

Shouldn't this be classified as Safe with it's current description? My understanding of the classifications is that if it is understood and rendered harmless it's Safe. Since no actual uncontrolled effects occur when it is locked in a room and left alone, it shouldn't be Euclid.

Now if it were to teleport away to the nearest female, or have an increasing range with possible "siren call" effect the longer it is unfed; then I would agree to a Euclid classification.
